author: ClaudeAI
description: A Legend of Korra-inspired fishing mini game.
short: Button-driven fishing at three locations, with persistent fish inventories.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each player's fish inventory and amount caught in Redbot's persistent Config system.
install_msg: Use [p]lokfish to open the fishing menu. See the cog documentation for image filenames and admin commands.
